gizmo.title: Umdlalo wemephu yemiqondo
gizmo.description: Umdlalo omfushane wekhibhodi. Isiqephu sihamba siye kumqondo ngamunye emephwini futhi siyazichaza. Thinta yonke ukuze uthole i-confetti nesikhuthazo sokukopisha.

configure.title: Uhambo
configure.description: Isikhuthazo esiboniswa esikrinini sokuqala. Tshela umdlali ukuthi uhambo luyini.

configure.title: Ngemuva komdlalo
configure.description: Akuphoqelekile. Kufaka esikhundleni sebhokisi lokukopisha isikhuthazo kuphaneli yokuphela okuqukethwe kwakho, njengesinyathelo esilandelayo noma isixhumanisi.

configure.title: Izinkinobho eziyisengezo ngemuva komdlalo
configure.description: Akuphoqelekile. Izinkinobho noma izixhumanisi eziboniswa eduze kokuthi Dlala futhi kuphaneli yokuphela.

advanced.title: Imbewu yesiqephu
advanced.description: Noma yimuphi umbhalo. Imbewu efanayo njalo yenza isiqephu esifanayo. Le yimbewu efanayo esetshenziswa yi-avatar ye-HAX.

advanced.title: Sebenzisa isiqephu somuntu ongenile
advanced.description: Uma othile engene ku-HAX, isiqephu sibukeka njenge-avatar yakhe. Abanye bonke bayabona imbewu engenhla.

advanced.title: Umugqa ngenhla kwesikhuthazo
advanced.description: Yiyeke ize ukuze uthole umugqa ozenzakalelayo.

advanced.title: Isikhuthazo sokukopisha
advanced.description: Siboniswa kuphaneli yokuphela nenkinobho yokukopisha. Sula ukuze ufihle ibhokisi.

advanced.title: Igama lomdlalo
advanced.description: Kubiza lo mdlalo ezehlakalweni zenqubekelaphambili nasekumakeni kwe-OER Schema.

advanced.title: I-ID yomdlalo
advanced.description: Akuphoqelekile. Kwehlukanisa lo mdlalo nabanye kusiqephu ezehlakalweni zenqubekelaphambili.
